But the coverage rate is 9/7 = 1.29 pixels per action, which is not great.
In the previous attempt, LEFT 20 covered 21 pixels (1.05 per action), and SPACE + LEFT 8 covered 18 pixels (2.25 per action).

Let me try SPACE + LEFT to see if it covers pixels now.
Actually, the key insight is:
- SPACE + LEFT covered pixels when the player was to the RIGHT of the gray bar
- SPACE + RIGHT covers pixels when the player is to the LEFT of the gray bar
So the beam needs to sweep across the gray bar to cover pixels.
Currently, the player is at cols 28-30, to the RIGHT of the gray bar (cols 13-18).
So SPACE + LEFT should cover pixels now.

    if n['color'] in ('N', 'W', 'g', 'P'):
        print(f"  color={n['color']} pixels={n['pixels']} boundary={n['boundary']}")
</parameter>

</tool_call>
